senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced.; cmp. גֶּפֶת) paste, plaster, esp. gypsum.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:2">Kel. X, 2</cite> we must use <he>בסיד בג׳ וכ׳</he> lime or gypsum &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:2:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>גיבסם</he>; Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ bot. <cite ref="C00795"><he>גִּיפְסוֹס</he></cite>, v. infra.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 4</cite> <cite ref="C01210"><he>גִּפְסִית</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <cite ref="C01209"><he>גִּפְסִיס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 8a:4">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>גפסית רותח</he>; <cite ref="Pesachim 75b">Pes. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>גפסיס רותח</he>, Ar. <he>גפסים רותחין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 4:7">Tosef. Mikv. IV, 7</cite> <cite ref="C01207"><he>גפסים</he></cite>; a. fr. [Greek adoption: γύψος, readopted <cite ref="C00795"><he>גִּיפְסוֹס</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00795"><he>גִּיבְסוֹס</he></cite>.]
